title: Cipher Monk: Cassette Equation
description: [Features]1. Simple, easy-to-understand controls - Intuitive one-touch interface. - It takes merely one minute to learn the controls! 2. Flawless physics - Smooth & sensitive movements. - Navigate your Sprite to save as many souls as possible.3. Beautiful, yet gloomy atmosphere - Sentimental & melancholy visuals. - Gloomy piano bgm makes it just better.4. Useful items and Star Powers - Pick up a magnet to attract nearby souls. - Fill soul gauge to max to make Soul Stars appear. Collect them for power-ups!5. Use special moves to evade dangers - Touch & drag downwards to activate Quick dive. - Touch & drag left to right to activate Soul Star Power and become invincible. Please Note!- This app contains cash items that you can buy via in-app-purchase.- Change of device/phone number may cause undesired effects, such as data reset.- Sudden shutdown by low battery may cause data crash.- Any use of cheats or illegal programs may result data reset/user ban.- Please contact help@pnjmobile for support.
